ACTION=A2
Rationale: A motorcycle is executing a cut-in maneuver from the right (y=3.5m) into the ego vehicle's path (target y=0.0m) at a relative speed of 8.4 m/s, starting from 18.8m ahead. Given the ego vehicle's speed of 50 kph (~13.9 m/s), the closing speed is significant. The cut-in duration is 1.3s, meaning the motorcycle will be fully in the lane in approximately 1.3s. The ego vehicle needs to decelerate to maintain a safe following distance and avoid a collision, making A2 (decelerate) the appropriate action.
